prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one universally “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your Houston neighborhood, how quickly you need service, your budget, the make/model of your AC, and whether you want a warranty/maintenance plan. 

If you want quick options, many Houston homeowners recommend (check current local reviews and licensing before hiring):
- John Moore Services — long-established Houston company, offers 24/7 service and full HVAC/plumbing.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing & Air — local firm with a strong Houston presence and good reputation for AC work.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (Houston) — national chain with lots of technicians and emergency availability.
- ABC Home & Commercial Services — regional/national company providing HVAC repair and maintenance.
- One Hour/Two Men and a Truck (local franchise names vary) — franchise networks that often offer same‑day service.

How to pick the best for your situation
1. Verify credentials: confirm registration with the Texas licensing authority (TDLR) or ask for the contractor registration number, proof of insurance and workers’ comp.
2. Read recent Google/Yelp/BBB reviews for your ZIP code (look for recent HVAC-specific jobs).
3. Ask about flat-rate pricing vs. time-and-materials, emergency/after-hours fees, and a written estimate.
4. Ask about warranties on parts and labor and whether replacements come with a manufacturer warranty.
5. Ask if the tech is experienced with your AC brand/model and whether they perform diagnostic checks before quoting.
6. Get 2–3 estimates for major repairs or a replacement.

If you want, tell me your Houston ZIP code and whether this is an emergency (no cooling now), and I’ll suggest 2–3 highly rated companies in your immediate area and give a short script of questions to ask when you call.
